# utensil_pitcher — Round 2 realism review

Evidence: f1119, f1123, f1133; source index / 30 gives capture seconds. Three calibrated photo/render/overlay comparisons: [review.jpg](review.jpg). This is offline reconstruction, not online estimation.

Grades: {'silhouette': 'B', 'proportions': 'A', 'colour_texture': 'B', 'articulation': 'A', 'physics': 'B', 'collision': 'A', 'instances': 'B'}. The unchanged grading thresholds and correlated-mask limitations are documented in [../qa_summary.md](../qa_summary.md).

## Round 2 repairs

- Replaced the flat reflection setup with a depth-reprojected source-colour kitchen environment.
- Rebuilt collision walls from the actual inner profile, using 48 angular strips; removed excess inward thickness while preserving the handle opening.

## Physics and contacts

Canonical envelope [0.209476, 0.122505, 0.195744] m; dry mass estimate 1.77524 kg; material density 8500 kg/m³; friction 0.35; restitution 0.12. See model.json for material components, inertia, COM, uncertainty and deformable fallback parameters. Product mass is not measured. There are 352 closed convex pieces; contact margin 0.0001 m. Container membership is not a weld or rigid articulation.

## Remaining limits

- Exact product identity, weighed mass and measured friction remain unavailable; density-derived masses and contact coefficients are explicit priors.
- Illumination is approximate. Photo histograms and source-colour reflection maps are not calibrated albedo or HDR radiance measurements.
- Cast-foot and handle ornament, exact alloy and tarnish layout remain approximate.

## Rebuild

Run Blender with `-b -P build.py`; the shared generator reads `../assets.json`, `../build_common.py` and `../qa_geometry.py`. OBJ coordinates are canonical metres, +Z up. GLB is glTF +Y up; Blender dynamic origins are at COM. Repeat the calibrated render, collision and metadata checks after rebuilding; old QA grades must not be assumed valid after edits.

physics_properties.mass_justification: 1.77524 kg from visual solid material volumes multiplied by nominal densities; manufacturing overlaps and unobserved construction remain uncertain. See density_mass_estimate.
